summary: Revised reconciliation of the five inventories into one standard, corrected against citation and critic findings. Adopt arc42 + C4, MADR-compatible decision records, EARS, Gherkin/Cockburn scenarios, Diataxis and Hypothesis model-based tests; keep Company Planning's durable_documents set and trace.yaml as AES extensions only where nothing off the shelf covers it, after a short landscape review of OpenFastTrace, Doorstop, Sphinx-Needs and mutmut. Of 15 concerns, 8 are conflicts (glossary, system model, decisions, plans, trace, enforcement, navigation, diagrams), 5 gaps (scenarios, behavior model, status/roadmap, handoff, open questions) and 2 aligned (goal, requirements). Key corrections this pass: Decision 0002 already ends the ODD allowance at each repo's next model change, and the fix is to make the checker do that (not to drop the grandfather clause); agent-skills/docs/model/ARCHITECTURE.md is the existing arc42+C4 template, and company-planning and agent-skills already run in refuse mode; AES already runs durable_docs_check through its commit rule, but that test skips silently when the CP checkout is missing; MADR Confirmation maps to the trace check, and 'Wrong when' stays a separate reversal field; the glossary is repo-scoped and links the cross-project ecosystem-terms.md rather than being it; v0.1 repo.yaml keys are relabelled, not removed (Decision 0010); the project-brain spec lives at agent-skills .rulesync/subagents/project-brain.md; the CP roadmap/status files are under plugins/company-planning/docs and date from 2026-09-09; the 8,000-character truncation is fixed in Team-Brains server.py with chunked reads, not by making owners shorten files; the brownfield-plan 'contradiction' was dropped (two pilots). Key additions: a durable_documents block currently gates plans by its presence alone, so no IS repo gets one until schema v0.2 adds enforcement: report_only and a decision record (0004) plus the AGENTS.md durable-documents bullet allow the new roles; project-meta's daily sweep gains an opt-in IS list as the named reporter; status uses a {check: command} form like catalog; only authorities.plan_roots widens; cli.py status is to be built; Team-Brains changes go up as PRs that need a recorded human approval per its AGENTS.md. One product call stays with Brian (C16). Synthesis only: no checker was run and no file changed; I spot-checked quick.py:421, the v0.1 schema's required roles, decision 0003's 'unaffected' line, the cli.py subcommands, Team-Brains AGENTS.md l.68 and the REQ-* finding codes (REQ-NO-SUCCESS does exist, so that critic point was not applied). Everything else comes from the supplied verification findings.
